text:
matt: promo hold. staging-smoke-22 failed unpacking sdist: checksum mismatch on redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-03-25. job=staging-smoke-22 exit=1 reason=artifact-checksum-mismatch
matt: logs show `tar: Unexpected EOF in archive` and `sha256 mismatch: expected aa11... got ff22...` when fetching `gs://ci-artifacts/sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz`
tara: that bucket has been flaky during the big GC job. I wonder if the uploader left a `.part` and the index referenced the final name before compose completed. can someone paste the artifact index entry?
ben: index entry: `{"key":"sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz","size":1048576,"etag":"ff22","uploaded":1735010005}`
qa-bot: quick check: `gsutil hash gs://ci-artifacts/sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz` -> sha256: ff22... (mismatch)
tara: confirmed corrupt. options: 1) reupload the correct sdist and retry job, 2) pin canary to previous build that passed smoke, 3) abort cut. release-manager: timeline — 30m to cut. prefer minimal disruption: try reupload+retry first, fallback to pin if reupload fails or takes too long.
matt: who has the canonical artifact? packager job ran on packager-09; build artifacts are on packager node and in ci-cache. I can scp the good sdist from packager-09 and reupload.
ben: if you reupload, set object metadata `x-goog-meta-final:true` before index publish, and set `x-goog-meta-protected:true` so GC won't remove it. after upload, call index update endpoint to ensure runners see it.
qa-bot: useful commands: `scp packager-09:/var/tmp/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz /tmp/ && gsutil cp /tmp/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz gs://ci-artifacts/sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz && gsutil setmeta -h "x-goog-meta-final:true" gs://ci-artifacts/sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz && curl -XPOST https://artifacts.internal/index/update -d '{"key":"sdists/redwood-cli-0.9.3.tar.gz"}' && deploybot retry staging-smoke-22`
matt: doing the scp now, will upload and tag.
(4m)
matt: upload done, metadata set, index updated. triggering retry: `deploybot retry staging-smoke-22`
deploy-bot: retry queued for staging-smoke-22. runner=smoke-runner-3
qa-bot: staging-smoke-22 started on smoke-runner-3
qa-bot: fetching sdist -> 200 OK, sha256 matches aa11... now, unpack OK
qa-bot: tests: smoke suite passed, exit=0
deploy-bot: canary promo resumed automatically after job success. Promo status: holding -> queued promote.
release-manager: proceeding with canary promote at 11:50 UTC. adding release note: transient incomplete multipart upload caused corrupted sdist; reuploaded and protected object. follow-up: uploader must finalize compose before index update.
tara: filed INF-523: ensure packager calls atomic upload (compose) and sets final/protected metadata prior to index registration; add upload verification CI check.
ben: adding runbook to eng-releases: on artifact-checksum-mismatch during promo hold -> verify gsutil hash, attempt reupload with meta flags and index update, retry job; fallback: pin previous canary image and follow escalation channel.
matt: thanks everyone. will close thread after promote completes :thumbsup:
